Here & Now offers you very charming, cozy, rustic and peaceful space, delicious and authentic plant-based menu from appetizer, main course to desert, drink... Very affordable price, welcoming and accommodating service staff. Definitely will come back!

reviews.review_text:
Huong N
16 contributions
0
Authentic food
Sep 2019
If you are a fan of vegetarian or simple love to take a break from your meat routine, Here and Now is a perfect place to eat. For sure there is more than just salad here. Though the ingredients are mainly rice, noodles, vegetables and mushrooms but they made it with different recipes like stir, fry, steam, slow cook and all. The taste has so much to tell. Not too sweet like most of local  dishes our there and not too salty. And so fresh! They did little decoration to the dishes to make sure all looks good outside and healthy and nutritious inside. Affordable prices compared to other vegetarian restaurants at the same range.

The location is not too difficult to find. You look for Effoc coffee from the main street then turn to a smaller street right there. The restaurant which is a three story house is right there on the left. This area is quite central and convenient where most of expats are living with lots of coffee shops, restaurants, hawkers for cheap eats and drinks.
